description_en: Grants permissions on host groups and host accounts to a user
description_zh: 为用户授权主机组和主机账号
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-host-group-accounts-to-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --host-groups HostGroupId_:_1_,_HostGroupId_:_2_,_HostAccountNames_:_root_,_111_,_abc_,_HostGroupId_:_3_,_HostAccountNames_:_root_,_111_,_abc_,_HostGroupId_:_4_,_HostAccountNames_:_root_,_111_,_abc --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachHostGroupAccountsToUser

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the user to be granted authorization on host groups and host accounts belongs.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机组和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the user to be granted permissions on host groups and host accounts is located.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机组和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user to be granted permissions on host groups and host accounts.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机组和主机账户的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the host groups and the names of the host accounts to which you want to grant the user access. You can specify up to 10 host group IDs and up to 10 host account names for each host group. If you do not specify host account names, the user is granted access only to the host groups. For more information about the structure of this parameter, see the HostGroups parameter structure description in the request parameter list.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to obtain host group IDs and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to obtain host account names
parameters.help_zh:
指定要为用户授权的主机组ID和主机账户名称。最多支持设置10个主机组ID，每个主机组最多支持设置10个主机账户名称。您可以不设置主机账户名称，不设置主机账户名称表示仅为用户授权主机组。该参数的具体结构请参考请求参数列表下的HostGroups参数结构说明。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取主机组ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取主机账户名称
parameters.name: host_groups
